{"type":"com.agentclientprotocol.rpc.JsonRpcNotification","method":"session/update","params":{"sessionId":"session-260618-163236-1bqj","update":{"sessionUpdate":"agent_message_chunk","content":{"type":"text","text":"**ACP Devtools**

This is **`acp-devtools`** — a developer tool for inspecting, debugging, and validating traffic between code editors and AI coding agents using the **Agent Client Protocol (ACP)**.

**What is ACP?**
The [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) is an open, newline-delimited JSON-RPC wire format that lets editors (WebStorm, Zed, IntelliJ, Neovim, VS Code via ReSharper) communicate with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Goose, OpenCode, and 40+ others) over stdio.

**What does this project do?**
`acp-devtools` acts as a **transparent proxy** sitting in the stdio pipe between the editor and the agent — neither side knows it's there. It:

- **Captures** every JSON-RPC frame in both directions
- **Stores** sessions in SQLite
- **Streams** data to a live web inspector UI
- **Validates** frames against the official ACP JSON schema
- **Provides** a CLI and a read-only MCP server

**Key Features**
- **Timeline + JSON detail** — scrollable frame list with full payload inspection, spec-aware tree view
- **Stream clusters** — `agent_message_chunk` runs collapse into one row with a shimmer bar
- **Spec validation** — invalid frames get badges; CLI exits with code 1 for CI gating
- **Performance dashboard** — per-method p50/p99/max latencies, waterfall chart, auto-detected insights
- **Multi-session diff** — frame-level + metadata + per-method p99 deltas
- **Playground** — browser-based inspector at [playground.acp-devtools.dev](https://playground.acp-devtools.dev)

**Who it's for**
- **Agent authors** — validate wire output against the spec
- **Editor/plugin developers** — inspect what the other side sends
- **Debuggers** — find why a prompt took 60s, replay broken sessions
- **CI pipelines** — gate releases on spec conformance and latency regressions

**Tech Stack**
- **Node.js ≥ 22** (TypeScript)
- **SQLite** for session storage
- **Vitest** for testing
- **ESLint** for linting
- MIT licensed, published on npm as [`acp-devtools`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/acp-devtools)
"}}},"jsonrpc":"2.0"}
